# Employee Benefits Handbook

This is the introduction to the handbook. It provides an overview of what's covered.

It can span multiple paragraphs.

## Health Insurance

Our company offers comprehensive health insurance plans to all full-time employees.

Coverage includes medical, dental, and vision benefits.

## Retirement Plans

We offer 401(k) plans with company matching.

The match is up to 5% of salary.

### Vesting Schedule

You vest over 4 years.

## Paid Time Off

We offer generous PTO policies.

- 15 days vacation
- 10 days sick leave
- 5 days personal days

## Professional Development

We support your career growth with training opportunities.
